description: This file defines the WorkShiftService class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It provides methods for managing work shift data, including retrieving default times, fetching by ID, and listing or counting work shifts based on filters. The class interacts with a DAO (Data Access Object) layer for database operations and utilizes configuration traits.

classes.name: WorkShiftService
classes.description: Service class providing functionality for managing work shifts, including retrieving default start/end times, fetching individual shifts by ID, and listing/counting shifts based on filters. It utilizes DAO and configuration traits to interact with the data layer and configuration system.

methods.name: getWorkShiftDefaultStartAndEndTime
methods.description: Returns an object with default start and end times for work shifts, fetched from configuration.

methods.name: getWorkShiftById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific WorkShift entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getWorkShiftDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the WorkShiftDao instance used for database operations.

methods.name: setWorkShiftDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO instance for work shift database interactions.

methods.name: getWorkShiftList
methods.description: Returns a list of work shifts filtered according to provided parameters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftCount
methods.description: Returns the count of work shift records matching the provided filter criteria.
